title: First Julia scripts, values and observable output
outcome: Run a complete Julia script, trace bindings and distinguish a computed value from printed output.

exercises.title: Change a count
exercises.hint: Change one input and recompute the arithmetic.
exercises.answer: The output follows the current source values. A previous Run does not supply hidden counts.

exercises.title: Keep a scalar snapshot
exercises.task: Bind y to x=4, then rebind x to 10.
exercises.answer: Integers are immutable values; rebinding x does not rewrite the earlier value associated with y.

exercises.title: Print deliberately
exercises.task: Compare a bare arithmetic expression with println in a script.
exercises.expected: Only explicit output is guaranteed to appear in the script transcript.
exercises.answer: The REPL has display behavior that is not equivalent to running a source file.

exercises.title: Inspect a type
exercises.expected: They are the environment integer type and Float64.
exercises.answer: The type describes the value representation and available methods, not whether the value is scientifically meaningful.

exercises.title: Diagnose a name
exercises.task: Misspell a variable in an owned copy of the program.
exercises.expected: An undefined-variable error identifies the failed name and source location.
exercises.hint: Inspect the first relevant submitted line.
exercises.answer: The diagnostic is evidence about a missing binding, not a reason to reinstall the runtime.

exercises.title: Explain first-call timing
exercises.task: Time a first and repeated call in one process.
exercises.expected: Their costs can include different amounts of compilation.
exercises.hint: The classroom starts a new process for each Run.
exercises.answer: Report the timing protocol; a cold call is not interchangeable with steady-state performance.
